name: easy-ssh
displayName: Easy SSH – SSH Client & SFTP Drag-and-Drop
description: SSH client in a VS Code / Cursor terminal tab: saved hosts, jump hosts, ~/.ssh/config import, Ctrl+click a file to download, open or delete it, drag and drop to upload. Nothing to install on servers.

easySsh.downloadFolder.markdownDescription: Local folder for files and folders you download. Leave empty to use your Downloads folder (the redirected or localized one on Windows and Linux); when there is none, the Desktop, then your home folder.

easySsh.plainClick.markdownDescription: Open the action menu (Download, Upload, Open, Rename, Delete) of file and folder names in the remote shell with a plain click instead of Ctrl+click (Cmd+click on macOS). This turns on terminal mouse reporting, so selecting text then needs Shift+drag (on macOS, Option+drag with `terminal.integrated.macOptionClickForcesSelection` turned on). Applies to new connections.

enumDescriptions: Show the fingerprint of a server Easy SSH and ~/.ssh/known_hosts do not know, and connect only after you accept it.
Trust a new server's key on first connect without asking (the 0.1.x behaviour). A changed key is always asked about.
easySsh.hostKeyPolicy.markdownDescription: What to do with the host key of a server seen for the first time. Keys in `~/.ssh/known_hosts` are always trusted, and `@revoked` keys are always refused.

easySsh.knownHostsWriteBack.markdownDescription: Also append host keys you accept to `~/.ssh/known_hosts`, so `ssh` trusts them too. Off by default: Easy SSH only reads that file.

easySsh.transferConcurrency.markdownDescription: SFTP requests kept in flight per file. Higher is faster on slow or distant links; use 1 for servers that misbehave with parallel requests.

easySsh.maxTransferFiles.markdownDescription: Most files one drop may upload, and one folder download may contain. Bigger folders are refused before anything is copied.

easySsh.keepaliveInterval.markdownDescription: Milliseconds between SSH keepalive messages. Lower it when a NAT or firewall drops idle connections. `0` turns keepalives off.

easySsh.keepaliveCountMax.markdownDescription: Unanswered keepalives before the connection counts as lost.

easySsh.autoReconnect.markdownDescription: When a connection drops, reconnect by itself (after 2, 5 and 10 seconds) into the same folder. Off: Easy SSH shows the reason with a Reconnect button.

easySsh.maximizePanel.markdownDescription: Maximize the panel when Easy SSH opens in it, and restore it when the last Easy SSH terminal closes. A panel that was maximized already is left alone.

enumDescriptions: Open Easy SSH terminals in the panel.
Open Easy SSH terminals as editor tabs.
easySsh.terminalLocation.markdownDescription: Where new Easy SSH terminals open.

enumDescriptions: The Windows OpenSSH agent when its service runs, otherwise Pageant.
easySsh.windowsAgent.markdownDescription: Which SSH agent connections with agent sign-in use on Windows when `SSH_AUTH_SOCK` is not set. Ignored on macOS and Linux.

easySsh.readyTimeout.markdownDescription: How long to wait for an SSH handshake, in milliseconds. Time spent answering a prompt (password, host key) does not count.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run check && npm run build
